new_invariants.statement: glass-fidelity-floor — every surface that DECLARES a glass rung (glass-wash/-quiet/-resting/-floating/-overlay or Card surface=...) MUST, in a captured render against the live page background, composite as translucent glass: a measurable backdrop-filter blur AND a fill alpha < 1 with backdrop content discernibly bleeding through. Satisfaction is a render capture (inv-38), never a class-grep. A rung that paints opaque-grey is a defect — root-caused to (alpha) a glass-ui dark-arm/overlay token regression → booked to glass-ui BB, or (beta/gamma) a fourier opaque overlay/shim → DELETED; NEVER a fourier !important fill override (inv-3).

geometry-continuity-floor — corner radius derives from the container or a --radius-* token (no raw per-site magic radii; squircle.css adopted on glass surfaces wanting continuous curvature); a focus indicator is a ROUNDED ring concentric with its field's radius (a glass focus-ring recipe / box-shadow ring honoring border-radius, or the glass-ui input focus primitive), NEVER a raw `outline: …; outline-offset` square. A render must show the focus ring tracking the field corners. A square/offset ring root-caused to glass-ui 4.0 input focus → booked to glass-ui BB; otherwise the raw outline is DELETED for the rounded recipe (inv-3, no !important, a11y ring stays visible).

control-affordance-floor — (a) every interactive control paints a discernible IDLE affordance contrast-floored ≥3:1 against its substrate (a tonal-accent fill/edge from the value.js OKLCH source, NEVER hover-only paint — a control invisible/washed until hover fails); (b) option/configuration controls occupy the LEFT authoring rail (asideSide=left, DEC-2) — a Configurator with controls on the right is a defect; (c) a tabbed instrument defaults to the GLASS variant (glass-track/pill), with underline admitted ONLY where a document-register affordance is argued in-charter. Satisfaction is a captured render of the idle state + an asideSide assertion.

render-verified-design-gate — the design invariants (33 design-source, 34 motion-proportion, 35 glass-fidelity, 36 geometry-continuity, 37 control-affordance) are gated on a CAPTURED RENDER at the M close (band-mapping + idle-state + focus-state + controls-left + no-desktop-tabs screenshots, backend-up), not a class/prop grep; a code-state assertion is necessary but the render is the binding evidence (composes with inv-6 gates-close-on-evidence + inv-9 surface-appropriate-evidence — the surface-appropriate evidence for a VISUAL claim is a pixel capture). The 8-critique class (opaque-glass, square-ring, underline-tab, washed-button, right-controls, square-corners, darkened-menu, desktop-tab-leak) is the canonical regression set the capture must clear. This is the consistent application of the §0 anti-chronic (planned-but-never-physically-verified) to the design axis.

glassui_asks.name: W-ON-GLASS-FG — overlay-band over-darken opt-out for a KNOWN substrate
glassui_asks.what: The glass-ui 4.0 rule :where(.glass-floating,.glass-overlay){--glass-tint-source: var(--glass-tint-ink); --glass-tint-strength: var(--glass-tint-strength-aa); --muted-foreground: var(--foreground)} (CONFIRMED at dist/styles/glass/ladder.css:200-202) applies the FULL unconditional AA warm-ink darken (≤24% light / 12% dark per the dark-arm) on the entire overlay band because it 'floats over an unknown surface'. Expose a per-app signal — honoring an ancestor --glass-backdrop-known: light|dark (or an app-root --glass-tint-strength the band reads) — so a consumer whose backdrop luminance is KNOWN can dial the overlay tint to the sub-perceptual floor (--glass-tint-strength-floor: 4% already exists at ladder.css:218) instead of the full AA darken, WITHOUT losing legibility. The token escape exists but is undiscoverable; co-locate a clean known-substrate declaration with the legibility logic.
glassui_asks.why: fourier's nav dropdown renders flat opaque grey over its known cream/dark shell (critique 08). fourier consumes glass-floating CORRECTLY — the over-darken is a glass-ui SOURCE default for the unknown-substrate case. inv-16 forbids fourier writing glass-ui; the no-!important directive forbids a local workaround. Every light/dark-substrate consumer (value.js palette menus, speedtest, words/Floridify, slides) hits the same flat-grey-over-known regression. Belongs in the ladder.

glassui_asks.name: W-ON-GLASS-FG — radius-matched glass input focus-ring rung
glassui_asks.what: Provide a rounded, inset, accent-tinted focus-ring primitive for glass-ui input/search/textarea: a box-shadow ring honoring the field's own --radius (squircle-aware), whose contrast target is the COMPOSITED glass fill (the --input-on-glass rung) — replacing the browser-default square outline:auto that sits offset beyond a rounded field, AND keeping the ring legible over a translucent glass surface.
glassui_asks.why: fourier's paper + gallery search show a square native blue outline proud of the rounded field (critique 11); the ring is on the <input> child while the border is on the wrapper → structural offset by construction. fourier's fix is pure adoption of the glass Input/search primitive once it ships the rounded on-glass ring — no fourier-local outline hack (forbidden), a11y ring stays visible. Every glass form field across the constellation wants this.

glassui_asks.name: glass-ui-accent-tone (RE-SCOPE of the booked ask)
glassui_asks.what: The contrast-floored 3-channel tonal accent (--accent-fill/--accent-edge/--accent-ink from one --tone, reusing value.js mixing+flooring) — re-scoped so the IDLE/RESTING fill (not just hover/active) is floored ≥3:1 against the page substrate. Ships as a CSS @layer utility + a useAccentTone composable.
glassui_asks.why: the colour-pop idle register is washed-out light-on-light on cream (critique 09 — re-diagnosed: the pills DO paint, the contrast is the defect); fourier re-derives this color-mix recipe ~57×. The floor must apply to the resting state, which the current booking implies for active/hover only. NOT in BB named scope → stays a fourier→BB ask via W-CROSSREPO-ASKS with kill-date = 4.1.0 publish.

glassui_asks.name: glass-ui-dockiconbutton-active (RE-AFFIRM + RE-SCOPE)
glassui_asks.what: An active?:boolean prop on DockIconButton stamping aria-pressed + data-active + a CONTRAST-FLOORED selected/idle visual register (both states clear the floor against light/dark substrates), backed by the accent-tone --accent-fill.
glassui_asks.why: fourier hand-rolls :class={is-active} at 7 dock sites where the class has NO backing paint, and the preset-pill idle reads as washed text (critique 09). The toggle's selected AND idle states must both clear a contrast floor — same gap as the preset pills.

glassui_asks.name: BB-CONFIGURATOR-STAGE-MOBILE-HEIGHT + ASIDE-WIDTH-PROP
glassui_asks.what: (1) The Configurator's .configurator-stage cell should resolve to a nonzero flex height in the mobile flex-column layout (fourier patches via :deep(.configurator-stage){flex:1 1 0%} — an inv-30 violation). (2) Expose :aside-min-width/:aside-max-width (or --configurator-aside-width) so consumers set the aside band without overriding grid-template-columns from outside.
glassui_asks.why: VisualizationView overrides the Configurator's internal grid at three breakpoints and reaches inside with a :deep stage patch (the only inv-30 violations in the layout). Both fixes let fourier DELETE the overrides and make the layout fully declarative — removing the last platform-over-library breaches at M.W8.

M is the EXECUTION tranche; this audit hardens it against the live critique without re-planning it. The 8 user critiques root-cause cleanly and confirmed at source: TWO are glass-ui-4.0-owned (alpha → BB W-CROSSREPO-ASKS, never a fourier !important): the darkened menu is the unconditional overlay-band AA over-darken at ladder.css:200-202 firing with no translucent backdrop to refract, and the square/offset search ring is glass-ui having no radius-matched on-glass input focus-ring (fourier hand-rolls a raw <input> with the UA outline leaking). FIVE are fourier adoption gaps (beta): the glass ladder unadopted, asideSide=left not passed, the glass tab variant not chosen, the idle-fill contrast not floored, the Input/search primitive not adopted. THREE are M.W1 bump residue (gamma): the underline-tab choice (faithful-to-migration but BACKWARDS as a design call — the headline correction), the .cartoon-card shim (15 live sites verified, not 25; the dead class glass-ui removed at C.W5), and the unfinished migration (STEP-2h slider retint left the sliders silently inkless; vue-tsc never gated — the TS2882 is masked by `-b` exit 0; peers --no-save; import-paths/Actions/lint pending).

The most load-bearing correction: M.W1's `variant="underline"` must be re-opened as a M.W8 DESIGN decision, not preserved as a migration constant — migration-faithful is not design-correct. The second: critique 6 is re-diagnosed from 'no idle paint' to 'washed idle CONTRAST' (the pills DO paint, light-on-light) — so the fix is the contrast-floored tonal-accent idle fill, not a missing fill.

The structural lesson the critique teaches is the FOUR new invariants. inv-33 (one source) and inv-34 (proportion) govern SOURCE and proportion but nothing bound RENDERED fidelity — which is exactly how the tree passed every migration gate while compositing opaque, square, underline, washed, and right-pinned. inv-35 (glass-fidelity), inv-36 (geometry-continuity), inv-37 (control-affordance), and inv-38 (render-verified-design-gate) close that seam: the design axis now closes on the SAME physical-gate discipline as deploy/consumer — the 8 critiques become observed-green captures, not the prose 'demonstrably shipped.' That is the §0 anti-chronic (planned-but-never-physically-verified) applied to design.

Sequencing: W0 (charter + invariants + ledger reconcile) and W1a (framework/sibling bump finish) + W2-W4 (deploy spine, bump-INDEPENDENT) stage NOW. The design waves W5-W9 author against BB HEAD now but execute on W1b, which is validly BB-gated — glass-ui is published at 4.0.0 and the 4.1.0 cut (BB W-CLOSE) is SPEC, so the value.js ^0.13/vue-router-5 peer breaches, the corrected overlay band, and the e2e-green dock-VT unblock all wait on that one publish.
